method: Read-only re-inventory. The live OpenSearch Security API (https://localhost:9200/_plugins/_security/api) required authentication not available in this execution context; per secret-handling policy credentials are never handled, printed, or logged. The re-inventory was therefore reconstructed from the authoritative persisted Phase 83 baseline evidence (phase83/phase83-evidence-rbac.json) and the post-reduction backups under ops/backups/agents/ (phase83-readall-rolesmapping-after-*, phase83-readall-role-before-*, phase83-internal_users-*, phase83-rolesmapping-all-before-*). No RBAC write operations were performed this phase, so these artifacts represent the current state of record.
secret_handling: Password hashes and any secret-derived material are intentionally OMITTED. Only non-secret identities, role names, index patterns, and mapping assignments are recorded.

readall: readall (mapping removed in p83; residual grant now explicit-user-only)

own_index.description: Allow full access to an index named like the username

audit_viewer.description: Separate audit-access identity; least-priv soc_least_priv does NOT receive audit-index access (justified separation)

soc_least_priv.note: Established least-privilege identity (role created p83, verified p83). Persists as the SOC read identity; temporary verification user soc_test_lp removed p83.
